steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I got a report that you spotted a white-haired girl with horns here?

steps.name: Timid Youth
steps.text: I'm not sure it's the one you're looking for.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Speak.

steps.name: Timid Youth
steps.text: She's really hurt, right? As in, there's a huge hole through her chest and stomach—

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Go on.

steps.name: Timid Youth
steps.text: A gray-haired Sankta came and carried her away. God, her blood spilled all over the place. It was horrifying!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: A Sankta? Are you sure?

steps.name: Timid Youth
steps.text: I guarantee you I saw a Sankta. Not a whole lot of them here in County Hillock. If it weren't for the glowing halo on her head, I wouldn't have seen her in the dark.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Where did they go?

steps.name: Timid Youth
steps.text: In that last house there, upstairs. The one with the broken window. She was running up a storm and jumped straight inside.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Over there? She's that close?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: P8, R3, this is B9—What were you two doing?! The target's in this district!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Your team should have already searched every last house on this street an hour ago. How come I haven't heard from you?!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: What's the funny idea? I'm not getting a peep from you! P8, R3, answer immediately!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Dia ár sábháil!

steps.name: Timid Youth
steps.text: Do you need me for anything else, sir? If not, I'll be on my way. And, um, I would appreciate those bandages you promised...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Bandages?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: You won't need them.

steps.name: Timid Youth
steps.text: W—What are you doing?!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Orders from the heads. You've got no one to blame but yourself for seeing what you shouldn't have—

steps.name: Timid Youth
steps.text: Aaarghhh!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Who are you?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Is that what they do these days? Give names before you fight?

steps.name: Timid Youth
steps.text: *Whimpers*... Ugh... T-That almost blew my brains out...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You'd better get goin'. I'll take care of this baddie for you.

steps.name: Timid Youth
steps.text: Th... Thank you...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: No need to thank me. All in a day's work.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Piledriver spear... A Victorian!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Quick, tell 'The Bandit'! There are still Victorian remnants in the area!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: 'The Bandit'? Do all of the spectre force have names that embarrassin'?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I think I just beat up a few screamin' about some boss person called 'The Convict...'

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: You took down everyone at P8...? Just... you alone?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: There were thirty of them!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Well, they were facin' the Victorian Army—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ant it doesn't change a thing just 'cause I'm here alone.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Form up! Surround her! She's on her own!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Formation again? Well, you've got it together, don't you!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Hold the line and press forward! Watch each other's backs!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: And watch that lance charge too! Don't take her on one-on-one!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh? Pilin' numbers up to take me down?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Don't you underestimate—my spear!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Aaaaugh! What the-?!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: This Vouivre's too strong! She can down two in one strike! Send the heavy defenders! Everyone else, fall back! Get word to the leaders—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh, stick around!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Last one!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Bloody hell, the armor's like paper to her!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Fall back! It's now or never!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Huh? Flyin' away on me?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Did you steal our steam jetpacks? Or is it flyin' machines from off foreign?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: This lot have a different combat style than the first ones we fought. There's no figurin' this spectre force, is there?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I wish Triangle were here. My spear can't reach anywhere near that high—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: They're droppin'?! Is there a crossbowman around? No, those aren't bolts. Are those... stones?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Gosh, that's definitely no crossbow—
Carrying the unconscious patient with one arm, Outcast steps out of an empty house on the side of the street.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Was that you just now? Thanks for the help!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: No need to thank me. You saved my ass too, after all.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I've always heard how good Sankta are with guns, but I never knew you could fling a rock so well!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Aha, sorry, little lady, my gunplay tends to draw a crowd.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Right. You don't hear gunfire every day around here.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Is your mate hurt? She doesn't seem so good.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: She was hit during the shelling around noon.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Sorry about that... We almost could've stopped that assault. It was a huge mistake, especially with all this innocent folk dragged into the mess.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ugh, no sense sayin' it now. I'm just tryin' to save as many as I can.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Are these hostiles here for you?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I reckon so.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I saw them huntin' the locals. I'm in a hurry, but I just couldn't stand by and watch that happen.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: They'll pay.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Whoa! I just heard 'em say they lost contact with two squads. I ran into one of them, but was the other one your handiwork?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Fine job!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You're mighty fine yourself.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But the enemy's got more than just the few squads. They have an entire army, and there's more and more of 'em pourin' into the city since the afternoon. It's gonna be hard to hold County Hillock.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: If you aren't a local, you'd better take your pal and leave the city now.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: We've got hostiles watchin' the alleyways. Looks like you'll have to leave the other way—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Or they're all blocked?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: How could there be so much debris in one city?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Well, they aren't here yet. I'll help you take care of what's blockin' the passageway out back first—

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You're not going to retreat?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'm not retreatin', no.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'll make my way through the city and regroup with my teammates.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Through the whole city? Crawling with enemies? With most roads cut off by debris?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Good thing I'm already halfway through, eh?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You're all alone, taking them by yourself, and you ain't scared one bit.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Scared? The battlefield's never scared me.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I am pretty worried, though.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I've never seen... a Victorian city in this kind of shape.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Lingones used to be a massive metropolis, many years ago. You could call it the capital of the world. But Victoria and its allies decided to burn it all down. One of man's greatest cities reduced to a raging inferno. It was a hundred times worse than this, believe you me.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Right. Our textbooks make us winnin' the Battle of the Four Emperors seem so glorious. The more glory they paint on, the crueler they are to the Gauls, even.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Victoria's done a lot of terrible things in the past...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It's not until the flames of war are lickin' at your home that you really feel just how painful it is.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: We're almost done. Just these fallen columns left—

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I'll help you.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Thanks! We just need to push it to the side.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ugh. One column goes down, and it might just bring another with it.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (Quiet mutter) Who knows what the future holds...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: No one knows where Victoria might go until the moment it gets there.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Sorry, I just can't stop thinkin' about all that. You shouldn't be helpin' move columns while you've got that lass on your back there.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: The job gets done faster when we work together.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Right, if we all work together, there's still a chance things could take a turn for the better, eh?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Haha, look at me blatherin' on and on about this stuff. What's the difference, even, if we lose the chance? What's so bad about things gettin' worse?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Even if your home's torn apart, does that mean it's not home anymore? You go enrich the soil again with your own hands. Isn't that what all the folk who live here should be doin'?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Phew... Last one!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: And the road's clear—

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: (Quick, the signal B9 sent's down this alleyway!)

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: (There's debris blocking the way out the back, but send a team around just to be safe!)

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: (The rest of you, stay and watch the entrance. Don't let anyone out. Our command will be here soon—)

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: There's more of them!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'll hold it here, Lass. Take your pal and get runnin'.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: That's gonna be difficult, kiddo.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You heard what they said, didn't you? Their leaders are coming, and I'm not expecting pushovers like we just fought.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: That's all the more reason you should go, isn't it?!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I guess I didn't say it yet—

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I'm not one to run from a fight.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Come, my young friend, give me a hand—
Outcast transfers the patient in her embrace to Bagpipe.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Whoa, that's heavy! Is she really a Vouivre?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Hah, not very polite to call a girl heavy.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Huff... Ugh... I doubt anyone else would be able to carry her.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Good thing I have a Vouivre friend, then. She's about your age, and a fairly tough warrior, too.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I want you to take the patient to the east side of the statue and hand her over to my friends.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Tell them I'm sorry I can't keep my promise. They'll know what to do from there.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I'm gonna stay a little longer. Got somebody to wait up for.

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: Is she in here?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Uh, yes, sir. Uh, the other officers are here, too?

steps.name: 'The Accountant'
steps.text: The intel says there are only three of them... and one of them is both heavily injured and unconscious.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: In the case, wouldn't just one of you be more than enough to deal with them?

steps.name: 'The Accountant'
steps.text: Two of them took down three squads, and without so much as a scratch.

steps.name: 'The Accountant'
steps.text: Are you telling me how worthless you all are, or does the mission matter so little that you don't mind messing up again and again?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: No... I wouldn't dare...

steps.name: 'The Convict'
steps.text: Huff... Huff... Are they really that tough?

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: At the very least, they're formidable enough that you're up and awake.

steps.name: 'The Accountant'
steps.text: It doesn't hurt to be a little cautious. Don't forget, we have both the unidentified Sankta and Victorian soldier, and she's there with them, too.

steps.name: 'The Accountant'
steps.text: You know what she can do when she's pushed to the brink, don't you?

steps.name: 'The Convict'
steps.text: Huff... I'm starting to look forward to this.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: The enemy's... got reinforcements!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Leader! This is Bagpipe, callin' Leader—!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Still not gettin' a signal... Argh! I need to get this girl over there right now...

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Huh... You're awake?

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: No. No...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Still asleep... but why's she strugglin' all of a sudden? Is she having a bad dream?

a.text: Bagpipe looks up, as though she feels something.
A few faint silhouettes look down at the commotion from atop a tall building nearby.
Bagpipe hasn't yet realized that the flames around her, unextinguished still, are starting to change color.
A young soldier who had just passed lies on the ground. The purple flames in his lifeless eyes look as though they could surge out at any moment.
She looks back down the street to see yet more hostiles approaching.

steps.name: Operator Shredder
steps.text: It's almost time.

steps.name: Operator Shredder
steps.text: The enemy's gathering over there. We can't stay much longer.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Let's give her a bit more time, Shredder. You know Outcast's always punctual.

steps.name: Operator Shredder
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Look! Over there! That's two individuals, incoming!

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Outcast, we're over here!

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Out—No, it's not her. Who's that running this way...?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Bagpipe?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Huh? So you're the cool Sankta lass's friend?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: That's perfect, then. Come, this girl's your pal too, right? She's heavily injured. The Sankta lass told me to bring her to you—

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Outcast...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Where is she?! Did something happen to her?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: She seemed like she was doin' alright when we parted ways...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Not sure why, but she told me to apologize to you for her. Said she can't keep her promise, and that you'd know what to do from here.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Then that must mean...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: She said it herself. We have to be sure we're safe before we help anyone else!

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Because that's how we save... even more...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: No—!

steps.name: Operator Shredder
steps.text: Jane! Don't go after her!

steps.name: Operator Shredder
steps.text: The Lass said it. We know what to do from here.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aye, I agree with him.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Do you trust her? I only met her the once, but I trust in her.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I reckon I knocked out some two dozen on my way here with this girl. Not sure if any of them are chasin' after us.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: The soldiers themselves aren't much of an issue, but if we run into their Caster leader... There's no tellin' how powerful she actually is.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So, take your friend, and get out of here.

steps.name: Operator Shredder
steps.text: What's that flash?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: An explosion?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: No, can't be. There's not a bomb out there with a flash this bright. Leastwise, not one we'd live through!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So it's Arts?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But usin' Arts to your extreme in such a short period of time, the Caster herself would...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: The blaze... the light... it blew through the clouds...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Did... the rain stop?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: That fire's from the west... Is it the alley from just now?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: If it wasn't for the direction, I would've thought it was bright out already...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: ...Right...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: The sky's... all bright.
None of them says another word.
The flames, kindling the skies, are still burning bright—
A raging fury that portends the impending end of the darkness above, or perhaps a shining beacon that impresses the brilliance of life on those aiding each other below.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: That's the most stunnin' daybreak I've seen...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: No wonder she said it'd draw a crowd, haha...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Operator Shredder
steps.text: Jane...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Huff... puff... I'm okay.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Shredder, is it time?

steps.name: Operator Shredder
steps.text: It is...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Let Uncle Oliver know... we got her.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: —Someone seriously infected.
